svg.aria-label: A payroll specialist uploads a collective agreement as a PDF. The pipeline read it and proposed 13 rules. Nothing is published yet. Each rule stands beside the clause it was read from, with the quoted sentence marked. A person approved every rule. Only then will the database publish them. An employer checks a payslip. The finding is arithmetic, and it names the clause. A question is answered from the agreement, with the clause quoted, or not at all.

g.text: A payroll specialist uploads a collective agreement as a PDF.
The pipeline read it and proposed 13 rules. Nothing is published yet.
Each rule stands beside the clause it was read from, with the quoted sentence marked.
A person approved every rule. Only then will the database publish them.
An employer checks a payslip. The finding is arithmetic, and it names the clause.
A question is answered from the agreement, with the clause quoted, or not at all.
